title: But Who Do You Say I Am?
question: Peter answers the question — where did his answer come from?
blurb: The question Jesus asks His friends directly. Sit with four other answers Scripture gives.

nodes.content: Peter answers the question — where did his answer come from?

nodes.verseText: “But what about you?” Jesus asked. “Who do you say I am?” Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah! For this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by My Father in heaven.
Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life. We believe and know that You are the Holy One of God.”
Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”
Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.”
